(c) "requires an undocumented movement leaving no trace" is an argument from absence carrying none of constitution section 6's record and no typed absence; the falsifier invokes ABSENT DESPITE ADEQUATE SEARCH where the record supports NOT ACCESSIBLE. Both rows assert in reason that neither is the default and neither is the other's correction. The evidence cells do not bear that out.

Either retrieve the burden-of-proof claim behind IH-031 or move it out of contrary_evidence into a note marked inherited and untested. Type the absence under section 6. Note the inherited record REJECTED the late-migration reading as the default at R-10 with the resolution "both live; burden on migration" - this branch honours R-10's prohibition and imports its verdict into an evidence cell with no retrieval behind it, which is the one thing inherited standing may never do.
